name: Northern Sonoma
description: Northern Sonoma AVA bounding box (UC Davis AVA Project, CC0) padded by 2 km; ~48 x 65 km. Frame for the viewer, not a geological boundary.

anchor.note: centre of the Northern Sonoma AVA bounding box (UC Davis outline); a frame reference, not a named feature

ava_rule: the parent AVA, every current AVA nested in it, and every current AVA whose bounding box lies inside the frame
frame_note: Two nested AVAs are kept whole but run past the frame and are cut at its edge in the viewer: Rockpile (about 7.8 km past the west edge) and Pine Mountain-Cloverdale Peak (about 0.9 km past the north edge, into Mendocino County). Widening the frame west was tried and dropped: it pulls in the Sonoma coast, where the terrain tiles have spurious depths down to about -14,900 m along the shoreline.
